title: Movie Night
summary: Join us for an evening dedicated to aviation through inspiring movies and documentaries, followed by an open discussion with club members.
description: An evening dedicated to aviation through inspiring movies and documentaries, followed by an open discussion with club members.

sections.heading: Recommended Movies
items: ✈ Sully (2016) — The true story of Captain Chesley Sullenberger and the Miracle on the Hudson.
✈ One Six Right (2005) — A documentary celebrating general aviation and the passion of flying.
✈ Living in the Age of Airplanes (2015) — How aviation transformed the modern world.

title: Aviation Quiz Night
summary: A fun evening where members test their aviation knowledge.
description: A fun and competitive evening where members test their aviation knowledge through various quiz formats.

title: Technical Workshop Series
summary: Recurring hands-on workshops: CAD, aerodynamics, electronics, astronomy.
description: A recurring series of hands-on workshops open to all students: CAD for aerospace, introduction to aerodynamics, soldering and embedded electronics, and telescope operation ahead of astronomy nights.
